name: Pellucid BioSync Augmentation Surgeon's Full Kit
description:
Sterile pearl-white surgical gown in Pellucid's BioSeal nano-weave, sealed at every seam and rated for chrome-implant theatres. Beneath it: a form-fitting antimicrobial underlayer in pale silver. The gown's wide back panel accommodates spinal rigs without breaking sterility. Hands covered by Pellucid's tactile-translucent smart-gloves that transmit haptic feedback through chrome fingers. Soft-soled mag-cling surgical shoes in matte white. A BCI-linked heads-up visor sits across the brow, projecting patient schematics.

Used in licensed gene clinics and chrome-implant theatres across Tiers 3–5. The visor is the giveaway — street ripperdocs covet salvaged units and can rarely afford the real thing.
functionality: Full sterile-field rated construction, haptic chrome-compatible gloves, spinal rig accommodation in back panel, BCI patient-schematic visor, mag-cling non-slip soles.
what_it_says: This person has the legal authority and technical skill to open you up and put something better inside.
story_hooks: A street ripperdoc on the Shelf is wearing a convincing counterfeit of this kit — but the BCI visor is a dead prop, painted to look active.
The surgical gloves log every procedure to a Pellucid cloud server; a surgeon needs someone to scrub six months of records before an audit.
A patient woke up mid-procedure and saw something in the surgeon's visor display that wasn't part of their chart.
